label: Countable same-history causal operation recombination for fixed-duration Reaper stations
definition: CountableStationRecombination R h Concrete k d w says that if a qualifying fixed-d descent and bearer assignment in an accessible populated history have a possible world of actual operation for every finite prefix, then a single accessible history realizes all station bearers' existence/presence, causal edges and all PieceAt signal rules for every natural index simultaneously. It preserves the entire chosen map and causal implementation, not merely the local laws. This is an OPEN countable modal recombination principle, not an inference from binary patchwork or finitary compatibility.
note: Analyst premise; attribution deferred. Separation: causalFinitePrefixControls (Comparator-certified with result 33b797cc) exhibits, in the structural surrogate causalPivot, finite-prefix station compatibility at (v = 1, t = 0) with no single realizing accessible world, so the INNER implication is not a consequence of finite compatibility; a statement-level non-entailment from 7d1b132f would need a model of all of 7d1b132f and is not certified. finitePrefixNotCountable is only the Nat quantifier-order illustration. Neither is a metaphysical objection. DEPENDENCY AUDIT (Lean companions of result 7fe26ec1): because GrimReaperPatchwork.arrangementImpossible excludes the consequent for every descent, this typed premise holds for a frame exactly when no populated fixed-d descent with a station map has finite-prefix-compatible station operations (countableStationRecombinationIff). The metric-finiteness conclusion 4365c3c5 implies it (countableStationRecombinationOfMetricallyFinite: a populated first moment of a d-slotted descent has a metrically infinite past), so given 7d1b132f it is equivalent to the conclusion it supports. Fixed-duration patchwork 313105b4 implies it (countableStationRecombinationOfDurationPatchwork), so relative to the fab16501 + 313105b4 route the new route uses a stronger local premise and a weaker gluing premise (implication order only; no strictness claimed). As for the spaced sibling 0e65cf83, its warrant must therefore come from the countable recombination principle it instantiates, not from this instance. STRONGEST POSITIVE RATIONALE: Koons's infinitary spatiotemporal patchwork PInfSP (p. 11, countable generalization presented as plausible) and Causal Power Network Patchwork CPNPP (pp. 14-15: a single possible world realizing all replacement patches with the specified causal-power graph), as read in docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md. Exact differences: (1) CPNPP's edges are powers to influence events, not actual Ontic.Causes edges, and PInfSP recombines duplicates with intrinsic powers, not actual exercises, so a power-to-exercise bridge is required; (2) CPNPP's per-node antecedent is a neighbourhood condition (each patch possible with duplicates of its predecessor and successor patches), weaker than finite-prefix compatibility, but CPNPP also presupposes the causal-power graph already realized in one possible world; (3) neither fixes a positive duration d, which is an analyst restriction. Granted the power-to-exercise bridge and CPNPP's graph-realization condition, CPNPP-type warrant would bear on this principle, whose finite-prefix antecedent is stronger. Countable hosts/protected channels/actual normal conditions must be separately warranted. The contradiction after granting this principle is the pre-existing GrimReaperPatchwork.arrangementImpossible.
